subject: SIG follow-up: change telemetry & transient credential stewardship
messages:
From: Elliot Sharp <sec+sig@orionpayments.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Assessment Team <assessor@sec-assess.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: SIG request — change telemetry + credential rotation artifacts

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking this. As part of the SIG intake for OrionPayments we need a compact package documenting your Secure SDLC controls focused on two specific areas:

1) Change telemetry: sample of PR/merge metadata (author, reviewer, timestamp), CI run IDs and outcomes, and any rollback/patch notes for the last 30 days. We don't need raw full logs, but we do need enough to validate enforcement and traceability. A CSV with a few rows is fine.

2) Transient credential stewardship: sample rotation logs for ephemeral tokens used by CI/runners (timestamps, TTLs, rotation actor), plus a short explanation of how long-lived secrets are avoided and where KMS custody sits.

Please let us know if you can provide these artifacts by EOD Friday (Dec 4). Also indicate whether you prefer to redact usernames or deliver a redacted bundle + a short attestation statement.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Elliot
Security Reviewer, OrionPayments
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Sharp <sec+sig@orionpayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — change telemetry + credential rotation artifacts

Elliot —

Appreciate the clarity. We can deliver a redacted bundle and an attestation by EOD Friday. Planned contents:
- redwood_sdlc_change_telemetry_sample.csv (PR id, author_handle*, reviewer_handle*, merged_at, pipeline_id, pipeline_status, rollback_flag)
- ci_pipeline_pr_gating_policy.pdf (policy excerpt and enforcement notes)
- transient_credential_rotations.log (redacted IDs, rotation timestamps, TTLs)
- short attestation signed by our Head of Security

*we will redact personal identifiers, replacing them with role tags (e.g., eng-reviewer-1) unless you need full identities for the assessor.

Quick question: do you need individual CI job logs or is the pipeline run-level metadata sufficient? We can include sampled job logs if required but prefer to avoid sharing large raw logs.

I'll loop in Jonas (serving runtime) to attach the rotation log and a short technical note on the Vault/KMS flows. Irene will confirm the attestation wording.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:42:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: SIG request — rotation log and implementation notes

Priya / Lauren — forwarding my notes to include in the bundle. Attachment: transient_credential_rotations.log (redacted). Key points to include in the assessor packet:

- Ephemeral creds: CI runners request short-lived tokens from Vault via AppRole + wrapped response. Default TTL = 15m, renewable=false.
- Rotation evidence: log includes token-issue-timestamp, requested_ttl_seconds, rotated_by_service (hashed-id), and rotation_event_id. We will redact runner hostnames and user emails.
- Rollback/patch telemetry: PR gating enforced in CI with a mandatory review label and branch protection. Pipeline records are retained for 90 days; the csv sample will show run_id, status, duration_seconds, and the merge commit.

Example log line (redacted):
2026-11-24T14:12:33Z | token_issue | rotation_event_id=evt_37b | ttl=900 | actor=svc-hash-2

Let me know if you want a small anonymized job-level stack trace for one failing run — I can attach one.

-Jonas
Senior Infra Engineer, Runtime
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Sharp <sec+sig@orionpayments.com>, Assessment Team <assessor@sec-assess.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — change telemetry & transient credential stewardship (delivery)

Elliot / Assessment Team —

Attached is the redacted bundle for the SIG intake. Items delivered to the Drive folder (link below):
- redwood_sdlc_change_telemetry_sample.csv (3 sampled PR merges, run-level CI metadata)
- ci_pipeline_pr_gating_policy.pdf (excerpt of our enforcement policy + how approvals/labels map to enforcement)
- transient_credential_rotations.log (redacted rotation events; TTLs; actor hashes)
- attestation_sdlc_signed.pdf (signed by Irene Choi, Head of Security)

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3sdlc-sample
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/deal/ORION-2381

Notes / clarifications:
- We provided run-level CI metadata rather than full job logs; if the assessor needs a sampled job log to validate a failure/retry scenario, we can produce a single anonymized job-level trace.
- Token rotations are machine-driven; no human secrets are embedded in CI. Long-lived keys live in our KMS; we do not store persistent plaintext secrets in repo or runners.

If helpful, we can run a 30-minute walkthrough this Thursday (Dec 3) to show the pipeline enforcement and Vault rotation dashboard. What time works for you?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Elliot Sharp <sec+sig@orionpayments.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Assessment Team <assessor@sec-assess.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — change telemetry & transient credential stewardship (delivery)

Priya —

Received the Drive bundle, thanks. The artifacts look good; the redaction strategy is acceptable. Two quick asks before the walkthrough:

1) Could you add one sample PR audit entry showing the review label change and merge timestamp (redacted user handles are fine)?
2) Please include a note in the attestation about retention window for CI pipeline records (you mentioned 90 days).

Thursday works for the walkthrough — can you do 10:30am PT? We'll have one assessor and one security reviewer join.

Thanks,
Elliot
Security Reviewer, OrionPayments
